comment: External trust anchor for the AttestArc knowledge plane. This file ships INSIDE the SSH-signed skill release and is the one root of trust that lives OUTSIDE any downloaded knowledge bundle. A downloaded bundle is trusted ONLY when its Sigstore build-provenance attestation matches the identity pinned here (repo + signer_workflow + oidc_issuer + git ref). cert_identity_regexp is authoritative for the SAN check: it binds not just the workflow path but the trailing @<ref>, so only the reviewed refs in signer_workflow_refs can mint a trusted attestation (the release tag ref refs/tags/knowledge-v<N> and the workflow_dispatch ref refs/heads/main). A bundle can never declare its own trust ('mode: bootstrap' is valid only for the immutable in-package snapshot). Root-of-trust: changes require two-party review (see core/promotion-policy.md).
